```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 5)
source(file.path(rprojroot::find_root("CLAUDE.md"), "R/lineage.R"))
library(pheatmap)
cfg <- load_lineage_config()
ds <- params$dataset
out <- lineage_dir(cfg)
set.seed(SEED)
# Write/replace this dataset's rows in a shared CSV (one file across datasets).
upsert_csv <- function(df, path) {
  if (file.exists(path)) {
    old <- read.csv(path, check.names = FALSE)
    old <- old[old$dataset != ds, , drop = FALSE]
    for (v in intersect(c("dataset", "cluster", "timepoint", "label"), names(old))) old[[v]] <- as.character(old[[v]])
    if (!nrow(old)) old <- NULL
    for (v in intersect(c("cluster", "timepoint", "label"), names(df))) df[[v]] <- as.character(df[[v]])
    df <- dplyr::bind_rows(old, df)
  }
  write.csv(df, path, row.names = FALSE)
}
```

Plan: `prompts/ob_lineage_plan_v1.md`, Phase 1. Pool rules, module lists and filter thresholds come from `config/lineage.yml`.

## Raw pool
```{r load}
raw <- load_raw_pool(ds, cfg)
obj <- build_clean(raw)
rm(raw); invisible(gc())
obj
mg <- module_genes(cfg, rownames(obj), ds)
knitr::kable(mg$missing, caption = "Module genes absent from this dataset (after build_clean, min.cells = 3)")
raw_tab <- as.data.frame(table(label = obj$pool_label, timepoint = obj$timepoint), responseName = "n_raw")
raw_tab <- raw_tab[raw_tab$n_raw > 0, ]
cat("cells:", ncol(obj), "| median UMI:", median(obj$nCount_RNA), "| median genes:", median(obj$nFeature_RNA), "\n")
if (ds == "zscape") print(table(obj$timepoint))
```

## Embedding and contaminant filter
Rule (per cluster, module means z-scored across clusters): drop when any contaminant z > `r cfg$pools$filter$contaminant_z` **and** ≥ `r 100*cfg$pools$filter$detection_min_frac`% of cells expressing ≥ `r cfg$pools$filter$detection_min_genes` of its genes (≥ `r cfg$pools$filter$detection_fold`× the pool median) **and** mesenchymal z < `r cfg$pools$filter$mesenchymal_z_max`; never drop a cluster with ≥ `r 100*cfg$pools$filter$protect_ob_frac`% annotated OBs. Re-embed after each removal; up to 3 rounds.

```{r refine}
ref <- refine_pool(obj, cfg, mg$modules)
obj <- ref$obj
e <- obj@misc$embed
cat(sprintf("final: %d cells, %d PCs, resolution %.1f, %d clusters, k = %d\n",
            ncol(obj), max(e$dims), e$resolution, nlevels(obj$pool_cluster), e$k))
cat("final round has no cluster meeting the contaminant rule:", ref$final_clean, "\n")
knitr::kable(e$sweep, caption = "Resolution sweep (final round)")
```

### Removed clusters
```{r removed}
removed <- ref$removed
if (is.null(removed)) removed <- data.frame(round = integer(), cluster = character())
removed$dataset <- rep(ds, nrow(removed))
knitr::kable(removed)
upsert_csv(removed, file.path(out, "removed_clusters.csv"))
```

### Cluster × module z (all rounds)
```{r zs, fig.height=7}
zs <- ref$zs
zs$dataset <- ds
write.csv(zs, file.path(out, paste0(ds, "_cluster_module_z.csv")), row.names = FALSE)
fz <- zs[zs$round == max(zs$round), ]
mods <- intersect(names(unlist(unname(cfg$modules), recursive = FALSE)), colnames(fz))
mat <- as.matrix(fz[, mods]); rownames(mat) <- paste0("cl", fz$cluster, " (n=", fz$n_cells, ")")
pheatmap(mat, cluster_cols = FALSE, breaks = seq(-3, 3, length.out = 101),
         main = "Final clusters: module z across clusters", fontsize_row = 7)
```

### Composition
```{r composition}
fin_tab <- as.data.frame(table(label = obj$pool_label, timepoint = obj$timepoint), responseName = "n_final")
comp <- merge(raw_tab, fin_tab, all.x = TRUE)
comp$n_final[is.na(comp$n_final)] <- 0L
comp$pct_kept <- round(100 * comp$n_final / comp$n_raw, 1)
comp$dataset <- ds
comp <- comp[order(comp$timepoint, -comp$n_raw), ]
knitr::kable(comp, row.names = FALSE)
upsert_csv(comp, file.path(out, "pool_composition.csv"))
cl_lab <- as.data.frame.matrix(table(obj$pool_cluster, obj$pool_label))
write.csv(cl_lab, file.path(out, paste0(ds, "_cluster_by_label.csv")))
cat("Cramér's V, cluster vs embryo/replicate:", round(cramers_v(obj$pool_cluster, obj$embryo), 3), "\n")
if (ds == "zscape") cat("Cramér's V, cluster vs timepoint:", round(cramers_v(obj$pool_cluster, obj$timepoint), 3), "\n")
```

### OB-gene detection per cluster
% of cells with ≥ 1 UMI. `any_ob_mature` = at least one `ob_mature` gene.
```{r ob-detect}
ob_genes <- intersect(c("runx2a", "runx2b", "sp7", "col10a1a", "ifitm5", "spp1", "entpd5a", "ihha",
                        "abcc6a", "col1a1a", "sox9a", "col2a1a", "twist1a", "prrx1a"), rownames(obj))
cnt <- LayerData(obj, layer = "counts")
cl <- obj$pool_cluster
det <- sapply(ob_genes, function(g) tapply(cnt[g, ] > 0, cl, mean))
om <- intersect(cfg$modules$lineage$ob_mature, rownames(obj))
det <- cbind(n = as.integer(table(cl)), ob_annot = tapply(obj$ob_annot, cl, mean),
             any_ob_mature = tapply(Matrix::colSums(cnt[om, ] > 0) > 0, cl, mean), det)
det <- round(det, 3)
det[, -1] <- 100 * det[, -1]
det <- det[order(-det[, "any_ob_mature"]), ]
knitr::kable(det)
write.csv(data.frame(dataset = ds, cluster = rownames(det), det, check.names = FALSE),
          file.path(out, paste0(ds, "_ob_detection_by_cluster.csv")), row.names = FALSE)
```

## Checks
```{r checks}
ari <- rerun_ari(obj)
cat("same-seed rerun clustering ARI:", ari, "\n")
stopifnot(ari == 1, ref$final_clean)
if (ds == "zscape") {
  n72 <- sum(obj$ob_annot & obj$timepoint == "72"); n48 <- sum(obj$ob_annot & obj$timepoint == "48")
  cat("OBs in pool: 72 hpf", n72, "| 48 hpf", n48, "\n")
  stopifnot(n72 == 186, n48 == 92)
}
if (ds == "fabian5") stopifnot(sum(obj$ob_annot) == 242)
obj$label_plot <- NULL
saveRDS(obj, file.path(out, paste0(ds, "_pool.rds")))
write.csv(data.frame(dataset = ds, cells = ncol(obj), clusters = nlevels(obj$pool_cluster),
                     pcs = max(e$dims), resolution = e$resolution, rounds = max(zs$round),
                     removed_clusters = nrow(removed), rerun_ari = ari),
          file.path(out, paste0(ds, "_pool_summary.csv")), row.names = FALSE)
sessionInfo()
```
